findings.observation: The Unforgotten - Part 2 displays level 6, Adventuring, Tanvu and Kojan. Both Starts with and Hand in to name Master Tallon Darkfist. Six recorded disagreements concern ends npc (gamepressure), level (the Forgotten Horde wiki), next quest and prev quest (silkyvenom), and starts npc (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80 and the Forgotten Horde wiki). The visible summary omits alternative values; all conflicts remain unresolved.

Objectives prints Last Words (1), directs taking the note to Master Tallon in the house to the northeast, and repeats that the found note must be brought to him on the beach. Notes locates Master Tallon Darkfist on the beach near the house. These are attributed instructions, not verified item identity, acquisition, interaction or hand-in mechanics.

Part 2 prints Previous Juu (Quest), Next Manifestations Of Jin, Training is Wisdom, and Series Shang Village. The previously reviewed The Unforgotten prints Next The Unforgotten - Part 2 and Series Dallerjuba Village. These navigation and series observations remain separate; no enforced prerequisites, canonical progression, or equivalence of Juu (Quest) with another quest is inferred.

Part 2 Location prints -21690, -62609, 3284 in Tanvu (-19, 6). Its map separately prints Starts spot 8, Juu, Tanvu (-21711, -67633), and Ends spot 10, House of Tallon, Tanvu (-2940, -80454). The starter map label differs from the Details starter; neither is silently preferred. Coordinate units, conversions and verified spawn remain unknown.
Coin reward prints 60 without denomination. This remains a literal display and is not converted into copper. No Repeatable field is displayed; absence does not establish repeatability.
